CMake extracts this immutable archive into the build tree and configures the
upstream project for a portable generic CPU, static-library, 8-bit AV1
encode/decode build. Tests, examples, tools, documentation, and test data are
disabled; high-bit-depth decode support is enabled so 10- and 12-bit AV1 input
can be normalized to SceneIO's uint8 in-memory representation. No build step
downloads native sources.
